#!/bin/zsh
# Read-only recheck of the eight worktrees cleared for removal. A worktree is SAFE only if it is merged
# into origin/main, has no tracked or untracked change, holds no ignored file besides .venv, caches and
# a data symlink to the shared data, is not locked, and no process has its cwd or a file open in it.
set -uo pipefail
REPO=~/leveraged-etf-risk-analytics
cd $REPO
OPEN=$(lsof -F n 2>/dev/null | grep '^n/Users/[REDACTED:private-term][.]s/leveraged-etf-risk-analytics/[.]claude/worktrees/')
LOCKS=$(git worktree list --porcelain | grep -B3 -E '^(locked|prunable)' | grep '^worktree ')

for n in ai-usage-logs baseline-collector-flake docs-closeout e2-evidence extension-baseline recovery-harness redis-cache result-cache-experiment; do
    w=$REPO/.claude/worktrees/$n
    reasons=()
    if [[ ! -d $w ]]; then print "$n | already gone"; continue; fi
    br=$(git -C $w branch --show-current)
    git merge-base --is-ancestor $br origin/main || reasons+=("not merged")
    st=$(git -C $w status --porcelain -uall | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    [[ $st == 0 ]] || reasons+=("$st status entries")
    ign=$(git -C $w status --porcelain --ignored | grep '^!!' | grep -v -F -e '.venv/' -e '__pycache__/' -e '.pytest_cache/' -e '.ruff_cache/' -e '.mypy_cache/' -e '.egg-info/' -e '.DS_Store' | grep -v -x -F '!! data' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    [[ $ign == 0 ]] || reasons+=("$ign other ignored entries")
    if [[ -L $w/data ]]; then
        target=$(cd $w && cd -P data && pwd)
        if [[ $target == $REPO/data ]]; then d="symlink to shared data"; else d="symlink elsewhere"; reasons+=("data link elsewhere"); fi
    elif [[ -e $w/data ]]; then d="REAL directory"; reasons+=("real data directory")
    else d="none"; fi
    print -r -- "$LOCKS" | grep -q -x -F "worktree $w" && reasons+=("locked or prunable")
    procs=$(print -r -- "$OPEN" | grep -c -F "n$w/")
    [[ $procs == 0 ]] || reasons+=("$procs open cwd/files")
    if (( ${#reasons} )); then verdict="KEEP: ${(j:, :)reasons}"; else verdict=SAFE; fi
    print -r -- "$n | $br | data: $d | $verdict"
done

}

    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]

files = links = dirs = size = 0

        elif os.path.isdir(p):
            dirs += 1
            h.update(f"d {rel}\n".encode())
        else:
            files += 1
            size += st.st_size
            h.update(f"f {rel} {st.st_size} {st.st_mtime_ns}\n".encode())
